name: X / Twitter Downloader
description: Resolves public X/Twitter videos with yt-dlp and downloads progressive MP4s, with an opt-in public photo/gallery fallback.
author: Kari

externalDependencies.description: Required for video resolution. Install separately and keep updated.
externalDependencies.name: yt-dlp

settings.description: Executable path; defaults to yt-dlp on PATH. No shell arguments.
settings.name: ytDlpPath

settings.description: Opt-in best-effort public HTML photo metadata extraction. Disabled when unset; no login or private media support.
settings.name: enablePublicPhotoFallback
